exact.放弃本局并诚实结算: Abort this run and settle honestly
exact.运行 recap 查看结算。: Run recap to read the settlement.
exact.运行 `actions` 查看当前合法动作。: Run `actions` to see the legal moves.
exact.这一局还没有结束，以下只是当前局面。: This run is still going; what follows is the current situation only.
exact.藤蔓被压出一道圆弧，土是往一边翻的。: The vines are pressed into an arc, and the soil is turned to one side.
exact.畦面留着一串浅浅的脚印，间距很大。: A string of shallow footprints marks the bed, widely spaced.
exact.畦边有两个对称的浅坑，像落地又弹起。: Two matching shallow pits sit at the bed's edge, as if something landed and bounced.
exact.它投下的影子比南瓜本身多出一个。: The shadow it casts is one more than the pumpkin itself.
exact.它的藤须绷得笔直，你一靠近就想撞过来。: Its tendrils are pulled taut. The moment you close in, it wants to ram you.
exact.它一边滚一边偷看你，像在等你追。: It peeks at you as it rolls, as if waiting for you to chase.
exact.它缩在畦角，藤须轻轻发抖。: It shrinks into a corner of the bed, tendrils trembling lightly.
exact.消耗 1 糖果，对暴躁的南瓜最有效。: Spends 1 candy. Most effective on irritable pumpkins.
exact.不花资源，对顽皮的南瓜最有效。: Costs no resource. Most effective on playful pumpkins.
exact.多花 1 体力，对怯生的南瓜最有效。: Costs 1 extra stamina. Most effective on shy pumpkins.
exact.只有几只夜蛾从叶子底下飞出来。: Only a few night moths flutter out from under the leaves.
exact.土壤是干的，连虫爬的痕迹都没有。: The soil is dry. There is not even a trail of bugs.
exact.你听见的只是风穿过塑料布的声音。: All you hear is wind through the plastic sheeting.
exact.叶子在动，但你没看清是风还是别的什么。: The leaves move, but you cannot tell if it is wind or something else.
exact.有什么东西从畦那头挪开了，很轻。: Something shifts away at the far end of the bed, very lightly.
exact.藤蔓晃了一下，又停住。: A vine twitches once, then stills.
exact.它猛地一扭，从你手边滑了出去。: It twists hard and slips out past your hand.
exact.它被你惊到，翻过田垄跑了。: You startle it, and it rolls over the ridge and runs.
exact.你还没靠近，它就已经弹开了。: You have not even closed in, and it has already bounced away.
exact.它慢慢软下来，靠在你手心里不动了。: It slowly softens and rests still in your palm.
exact.南瓜怪呼噜了一声，藤须垂下来。: The pumpkin spirit rumbles once, and its tendrils droop.
exact.它最后滚了半圈，停下来，安静了。: It rolls a last half-turn, stops, and goes quiet.
exact.田里进了南瓜怪。先弄清它在哪，再想怎么安抚。: Pumpkin spirits have entered the field. Find where they are before you think about soothing them.
exact.第一夜开始：六畦田，两三个南瓜怪。: Night one begins: six beds, two or three pumpkin spirits.
exact.体力耗尽，你倒在田埂上，天亮也没起来。: Stamina runs out. You fall on the ridge and do not rise at dawn.
exact.体力见底就是终局：每个动作前先算清还能撑几次。: Hitting zero stamina is the end: before each action, count how many you can still afford.
exact.今夜大暴走：每做一个动作，所有南瓜怪都会换畦。: Tonight is a full rampage: after every action, every pumpkin spirit changes beds.
exact.田里暂时安静。: The field is quiet for now.
exact.大暴走：每个动作之后，所有南瓜怪都会换畦。: Full rampage: after every action, every pumpkin spirit changes beds.
exact.第四夜结束前要凑够: Must be met by the end of Night 4
exact.这里有东西在动。花 1 体力看清它是什么、什么情绪。: Something is moving here. Spend 1 stamina to see what it is and what mood it is in.
exact.花 1 体力翻一遍叶子，确认这里没有南瓜怪。: Spend 1 stamina to turn the leaves and confirm there is no pumpkin spirit here.
exact.情绪未知的南瓜怪: a pumpkin spirit of unknown mood
exact.进 1 个南瓜、回 1 把南瓜籽；小概率是特殊南瓜（分值更高）。: Gain 1 pumpkin and 1 handful of seeds; a small chance of a special pumpkin (higher score).
exact.这一畦就能收了。: This bed is ready to harvest.
exact.种下之后还要浇一次水才能收。: After planting, water once more before you can harvest.
exact.花 2 体力：最多 3 只南瓜怪暴露位置，但都会被惊到（躁动 +1，下一动作后会: Spend 2 stamina: up to 3 pumpkin spirits reveal their positions, but all are startled (unrest +1, and they will scatter after the next action).
exact.消耗 1 南瓜籽，回 1 体力。: Spend 1 pumpkin seed to restore 1 stamina.
exact.在田埂上歇一会: Rest a while on the ridge
exact.回 3 体力，但占掉一个动作。: Restore 3 stamina, but it costs an action.
exact.剩下的动作作废，体力带到明晚（明晚还会再回 4）。: Remaining actions are forfeit. Stamina carries to tomorrow night (which also restores 4).
exact.这个南瓜的纹路是旋的——特殊南瓜，能换造型家具，南瓜籽也多一把。: This pumpkin's grain runs in a spiral — a special pumpkin. It can be traded for sculpted furniture, and it gives an extra handful of seeds.
exact.你喊了一声，田里没人应——本来就没有南瓜怪。: You shout once. No one answers in the field — there were no pumpkin spirits to begin with.
exact.你沿着田埂喊了一嗓子。: You shout once along the ridge.
exact.嚼了一把生南瓜籽，回 1 体力。: You chew a handful of raw seeds and restore 1 stamina.
exact.你放下手电，走回屋裡——这一季先不管了。: You set down the flashlight and walk back to the house — this season can wait.
exact.动作分配基本对上了：找怪、安抚、铺田三条线都没有断。: The action split mostly landed: finding, soothing, and laying beds never fully broke.
exact.写下这局你把六个动作分给了“找怪 / 安抚 / 种田”的哪几条，以及下一次第一夜: Write down how you split the six actions among finding, soothing, and farming, and what you will do first on Night 1 next time.
exact.这一季还没收尾。: This season is not over yet.
exact.四夜六动作，找怪、安抚、收成: Four nights, six actions: find, soothe, harvest
exact.南瓜田里进了会滚、会跑、会弹、会飞的南瓜怪。你要在天亮前摸进六畦田，靠一次查看换: Pumpkin spirits that roll, run, hop, and fly have entered the pumpkin field. Before dawn you slip through six beds, and one look buys you the kind and the mood that decide whether you offer candy, hum a tune, or pat the tendrils. At the same time you plant, water, and harvest — all from the same stamina pool. On Night 3 every pumpkin ramps at once, and each action makes them change beds.
exact.new 之后先 act probe:p1 看清田里有什么；没探明情绪就安抚会丢掉: After new, start with act probe:p1 to see what is in the field. Soothing before you read the mood wastes the affinity bonus.
exact.安抚用 act soothe:candy:p1 / soothe:song:p1: Soothe with act soothe:candy:p1 / soothe:song:p1 / soothe:pat:p1. Affinity follows mood: candy for irritable, a song for playful, a pat for shy.
exact.cook 消耗 1 个南瓜换体力上限 +2，是唯一的长期成长；eat-seed: cook spends 1 pumpkin for stamina cap +2, the only long-term growth; eat-seed / rest restore a little stamina.
exact.rally 一次暴露最多 3 只南瓜怪的位置，但会把它们惊到（躁动 +1）。: rally reveals the positions of up to 3 pumpkin spirits at once, but startles them (unrest +1).
exact.end-night 提前收工：剩下的动作作废，但体力会带到明晚。: end-night clocks out early: remaining actions are forfeit, but stamina carries to tomorrow night.
exact.种田是 plant:p1 → water:p1 → harvest:p1，三步各: Farming is plant:p1 → water:p1 → harvest:p1, three steps that each cost an action; a harvest yields a pumpkin and seeds.
